text.7:164: And when a community among them said: Why preach ye to a folk whom Allah is about to destroy or punish with an awful doom, they said: In order to be free from guilt before your Lord, and that haply they may ward off (evil).
text.30:57: In that day their excuses will not profit those who did injustice, nor will they be allowed to make amends.
text.40:52: The day when their excuse availeth not the evil-doers, and theirs is the curse, and theirs the ill abode.
